subject: Onboarding handshake: MAPlet + rollout cadence for Halcyon Systems
messages:
From: Ari Patel <ari@halcyon.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@halcyon.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps and timelines (Halcyon)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency and the cost controls. Procurement wanted a short, mutual-action-style plan we can attach to our internal kickoff so everyone (ops, security, procurement) understands key milestones and owners.

I've attached a quick worksheet (HAL_MAP_v0.9.xlsx) that our PM built — it lists the main milestones we care about: network review, SOC evidence review, staging traffic test, and go-live. Can you confirm Redwood's owners and realistic target dates? Aim is to begin the technical kickoff week of Sep 22 if that works.

Also, procurement will need a draft SOW they can review in parallel. Can we get a one-page SOW skeleton this week?

Appreciate it,
Ari

--
Ari Patel
Sr. Product Ops, Halcyon Systems
ari@halcyon.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: HAL_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (spreadsheet, 18KB)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari@halcyon.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding handshake: MAPlet + rollout cadence for Halcyon Systems

Ari — thanks for the worksheet and the clear ask. High level: Sep 22 kickoff is viable. I've sketched a "MAPlet" (condensed MAP) below with owners and target dates; I attached an editable MAP and I will drop a one-page SOW skeleton by end of day Friday.

Quick MAPlet (owner — target):
- Security questionnaire & SOC evidence handoff — Soojin Lee — target: 2025-09-17
- VPC peering / IP allowlist & network validation — Ben Carter (infra eng) — target: 2025-09-24
- Integration staging window (traffic replay) — Marissa Cole (CS PM) + Halcyon engineering — 2025-10-01 to 2025-10-07
- Performance verification (p99 latency & throughput) — Ben & Redwood runtime team — 2025-10-09
- Cutover readiness & go/no-go review — Dylan Brooks & Halcyon PM — target: 2025-10-14

Risks to flag up-front:
- If SOC evidence review needs 3rd-party attestations, expect a 2-week slip.
- If we need dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) instead of hosted, procurement lead time for capacity commit may add 3 weeks.

Deliverables this week (from Redwood):
- One-page SOW skeleton (EOD Fri 9/12) — Dylan Brooks
- Editable MAP (HAL_MAP_v1.0) — Marissa Cole
- Initial runbook template for staging replay — Ben Carter

I'll also include links to our standard onboarding runbook in the MAP so your ops team can see the cadence and required support. Please confirm if Halcyon's legal/procurement timeline requires any accelerated artifacts.

— Dylan

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Attachment: MAP_HAL_v1.0.xlsx (spreadsheet, 22KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 08:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding handshake: MAPlet + rollout cadence for Halcyon Systems

Thanks — quick internal sync notes so we stay tight before the customer kickoff: 

1) Security/SOC path (Soojin) — I will map the exact evidence bundle and timeline. If Halcyon needs our SOC 2 report plus system diagrams, we can turn those around by 9/17. I'll add a checklist to MAP_HAL_v1.0.

2) Network (Ben) — I need Halcyon's CIDR blocks and a test subnet by 9/18; target for validation 9/24. Ben, flag if you need a staged NAT or fixed egress IPs.

3) CS playbook & replay (Marissa) — I'll split the staging window into two: smoke (3 days) then load (4 days). We should book the load window now and inform the runtime team of expected RPS.

Action items (internal):
- Ben: provide runbook stub and expected egress IP list — due 9/12
- Marissa: import Ari's worksheet into MAP_HAL_v1.0 and build issues column — due 9/11
- Dylan: SOW skeleton + procurement bullet points — due 9/12
- Soojin: SOC evidence checklist and redaction notes — due 9/17

I'll be on the kickoff call the week of 9/22. If anyone thinks the dates above are optimistic, call it out now so we can present realistic commitments to Halcyon.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Ari Patel <ari@halcyon.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding handshake: MAPlet + rollout cadence for Halcyon Systems

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the MAPlet. Procurement confirms they can review a one-page SOW; please send the SOW skeleton and the editable MAP before Friday 9/19.

Halcyon notes and clarifications: 
- SOC evidence: we only need the SOC 2 Type II report and the system diagram; redaction for customer names is fine.
- Network: procurement will share the CIDR block and a named contact (network eng) by EOD Tue 9/16.
- Staging load: target RPS is ~120 requests/sec, roughly matching our expected peak. We'll coordinate a 4-day window as you proposed.

Can we add a short governance cadence to the MAP: weekly 30-minute checkpoint during staging, and a final go/no-go on 2025-10-14? That helps our ops team plan.

If you send the two artifacts (SOW skeleton + MAP_HAL_v1.0) I'll route them internally.

Best,
Ari

--
Ari Patel
Sr. Product Ops, Halcyon Systems
Attachment: Procurement-Timeline-Note.txt (plain text, 2KB)
